topic: The Rhythm of Mathematics: Understanding Music and Measure Theory
target_audience: High school students interested in music theory and STEM

sections.title: Introduction: The Heartbeat of Music
lecture_lines: Music is organized by steady pulses.
We group these pulses to create structure.
This fundamental unit of time is a measure.
animations: Display steady pulse with glowing #FFD700 circle.
Show waveform visual, emphasizing rhythmic regularity, #FFFFFF color.
Add metronome [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg] visual clicking on strong beats, #FF4500.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Fractional Time Divisions
lecture_lines: Notes represent specific fractions of time.
A whole note equals the entire bar.
Half notes split the whole in two.
animations: Draw a circle using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pie.svg], split into halves, labels #00FFFF.
Further divide into fourths, highlight with #FF69B4.
Animate parts coming together to form a whole using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pie.svg], #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Defining the Time Signature (The Mathematical Formula)
lecture_lines: Time signatures act like mathematical formulas.
The top number counts beats per measure.
The bottom note value defines the beat.
animations: Write 4/4 as a large equation, white #FFFFFF, accompanied by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg].
Flash top number '4' in #FF4500, label beats.
Flash bottom number '4' in #00FF00, label note type.
Highlight the first beat with a bright circle, #FFD700, and display a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/clock.svg].

sections.title: Measure Theory in Action: Grouping and Emphasis
lecture_lines: We emphasize beats to create rhythm.
Strong and weak beats define the groove.
Accents follow patterns within the measure.
animations: Show a bar line, color #FFFFFF, clear and bold, accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg].
Grouping note symbols within bar, color #00FFFF.
Emphasize downbeat with a color pulse #FF4500.
Shift emphasis through different groupings, varying #FFFFFF shades.
Animate flow of measures across the screen, #FFFFFF, with rhythmic pulse indicated by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drumsticks.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion: The Universal Language
lecture_lines: Music is sound arranged in time.
Measure theory is the underlying architecture.
We now understand the math of music.
animations: Show musical notation [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/notes.svg] fading into abstract geometry, #FFFFFF.
